session.title: 1.0.35 agent control of the whole app; 1.0.36 Lock in; friend's aiberm guides; fleet updated
session.purpose: Write Chinese setup instructions for a friend pointing Switchy at aiberm; make every window action controllable by an agent; add a Lock in control so one account is used whatever rotation picks; release Windows and macOS builds and update the laptop and another user's machines.
decision_pointers: C:/Projects/Switchy/DECISION_LOG.md#2026-10-19 — Agents run any window command over the proxy's port, which is served from launch
C:/Projects/Switchy/DECISION_LOG.md#2026-10-19 — Lock in is a hold with no end, ended by an unlock or another pick by hand
outcomes: Answered: the macOS build has the same UI as Windows apart from the overlay title bar, the menu-bar tray, the terminal list and Windows-only WSL/PowerShell settings. Wrote the user's friend a Chinese guide (install, add a custom aiberm provider: Claude Code request address https://aiberm.com without /v1, Codex https://aiberm.com/v1; leave the proxy and pool off), then a Chinese brief for the friend's agent to do the same setup through the control routes, asking for the API key if not yet given. the user rejected a version that told the agent to test with claude.

1.0.35: POST /switchy/invoke {command,args} runs any Tauri or plugin command through the main window's own handler (Webview::on_message with the invoke key), so it has the UI's arguments, ACL and behaviour; GET /switchy/commands lists the 191 commands with camelCase argument names, generated by build.rs from generate_handler! and the command signatures. Both refuse non-loopback callers and any request with an Origin header (the router's CORS is open). The proxy's port now opens at launch in the proxy-off state (listen_for_control), so the routes answer with the proxy off; unit-tested, not observed live because the workstation's proxy is on. The window refreshes on an agent-invoked event. Live on the workstation: listed 191 commands, ran reads, added and deleted a provider, refused an unknown command and an Origin request.

1.0.36: Lock in. A lock is the manual hold without its 10-minute expiry: the proxy serves only that account, with no failover or rotation; enabling another account by hand ends it, re-enabling the locked one keeps it; stored per app in the settings table (account_locks) and restored at launch (verified across a reinstall restart). Commands lock_account, unlock_account, get_account_locks; /switchy/accounts reports locked. UI after the user's feedback: a lock icon toggle next to Edit on Official Claude/Codex cards, open lock = unlocked, closed highlighted lock = locked; first versions (a text button whose filled state meant locked) were rejected as inconsistent with Enable. the user declined a pin that only reordered rotation; he asked for a lock button only.

Claude on the workstation is locked on registered2nd (ccb19499) at the user's request; live requests served by it. Anthropic reports its weekly reset as 2026-10-25 21:00, not before 10/22 as the user expected; the account resetting 10/22 01:00 is the Apple relay (58cad6b9, 75% used). Told the user; he has not replied on it. An Enable click on 58cad6b9 at 04:43 ended the first lock (by design), and rotation then moved Claude back until it was locked again.

Released v1.0.35 and v1.0.36 on registered2nd/switchy (latest = v1.0.36) with exe, msi and the Apple Silicon dmg from build-macos.yml runs 39218882606 and 39248587758; each dmg was checked (7z integrity, version, Mach-O arm64, new routes present) and asset digests matched local files. The NSIS helper-DLL cache was mis-hashed again and replaced by hand per LEARNINGS.md.

Updated the fleet from 1.0.30 to 1.0.36: laptop (relaunched in its console session, port and control routes up, 194 commands), another user's Mac (app replaced, quarantine cleared, reopened, port up in 3 s, 194 commands; first run of the new Mac build on a real Mac), another user's PC (installed, left not running as it was). The copied installers remain in each machine's Downloads.

One test, update_current_claude_provider_syncs_live_when_proxy_takeover_detected_without_backup, fails on the workstation because it binds the default port 15721 that the running Switchy holds; it is environmental and was not changed.
session.latest_summary: 1.0.35 makes every window command callable by an agent over /switchy/invoke (port open from launch); 1.0.36 adds Lock in as a lock-icon toggle. Both released for Windows and Apple Silicon; workstation, laptop and another user's Mac and PC updated. Claude locked on registered2nd.

current_focus.summary: Switchy 1.0.36 is the latest public Windows and Apple Silicon release. It is installed on the workstation, the laptop and another user's Mac (all running) and on another user's PC (not running, as before). Agents can run any window command over /switchy/invoke, and Official Claude/Codex cards have a Lock in icon toggle. On the workstation Claude is locked on registered2nd (ccb19499) at the user's request; its weekly reset reads 2026-10-25, which the user had expected before 10/22, and he has not said whether to keep that lock or move it to the Apple-relay account that resets 10/22. The requested work is complete; await the user's feedback. Earlier renewal, restart, WSL, rotation and proxy-off checks stay pending under their triggers.

next_actions.summary: Confirm account-proxy coverage on the next natural Claude sign-in or renewal while Owen is selected, without forcing a new login. Claude Code's own exchange should log '[connect_tunnel] platform.claude.com:443 via socks5://82.26.163.142:45001'. For Switchy's renewal, observe '[claude_pool] refreshing login for provider=98e00f12...' and the successful refreshed-login message; the enforced per-account client route is owned by proxy/http_client.rs. Windows/WSL HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY, UK exit probes and telemetry tunnels were verified; a live sign-in/renewal using this route remains unobserved. Connection failures must stop rather than fall back to direct; country observations only warn.

CONFIRM THE RESTART PATH ON STEPHEN'S NEXT WINDOWS RESTART (1.0.29). In C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.prev.log after 'Session ending; handing the live configs back': '[session-end] claude/codex/gemini handed back', '[session-end] ... in WSL handed back', then 'Live configs handed back for the session end'. 'did not finish in 4 seconds' with the last [session-end] line shows which step stalls (Windows step = database lock, WSL step = WSL I/O); fix that step. In switchy.log: Switchy started within seconds of login (window hidden, launched with --autostart from HKCU Run), '[auto_launch] start at login on', proxy on 15721, and Claude Code / Codex answer without ECONNREFUSED.

CONFIRM CLAUDE LOGINS STAY IN STEP WITH WSL (1.0.27). In switchy.log, when an account WSL is signed in to renews: '[claude_pool] provider=... took the newer login from WSL' or 'wrote the refreshed login through to WSL', and no new 'invalid_grant' 'Refresh token not found or invalid' in account_switches/provider_health. WSL's ~/.claude/.credentials.json and ~/.switchy/accounts/<id>/credentials.json for that account should carry the same refreshToken after each renewal.

CONFIRM ROTATION AND CODEX FAILOVER ON LIVE TRAFFIC (1.0.25/1.0.26). In C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.log and the switchy.db account_switches table: (a) when an account's five-hour window resets while another serves, a switch back to it with reason 'recovered' and detail "Another account's weekly limit resets sooner"; (b) a Codex turn refused for usage that continues an earlier one logs '[CodexWS] provider=... websocket closed (turn refused for usage; Codex resends it in full)' and the turn then completes on the next account with no error in Codex. GET http://127.0.0.1:15721/switchy/accounts shows current account, pool order, quota and atLimit per account.

VERIFY LOCAL PROXY OFF WITH AN OPEN CODEX WINDOW. the user was asked to turn Local proxy off in Settings > Pool, then use a Codex window opened while the proxy was on. Confirm in C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.log that "Proxy turned off; its listener stays up..." was logged, that the Codex window's later [Codex] requests still reached the proxy and answered, that netstat shows 127.0.0.1:15721 still LISTENING, and that Settings shows the proxy as off. Turning it back on must reuse the listener.

QUIT CASE WAITS ON STEPHEN. Quitting Switchy still breaks Codex windows opened under the proxy. He was offered a warning on quit naming the open Codex windows (small) or running the proxy as a process that outlives Switchy's window (large); he has not chosen. Build nothing until he does.
If the user directs request logging to be enabled, first make the Usage page's Turn on button apply to the running proxy, then enable it for Claude, Codex, and Gemini.
